title: Florian Metwaly
text:
Hi!
I am a PhD student in the Psychological Methods Group at the University of Amsterdam and a member of the Bayesian Graphical Modeling Lab. My research focuses on Bayesian methods for intensive longitudinal data, with particular interests in computation, network modeling, and causality. I aim to make all my research and software openly available as open source.
